description: Up to three entities related to roles played by an organization, as registered in the PDC: a changemaker role, a data provider role, and/or a funder role, alongside the organization's cached Keycloak identity.

keycloakOrganizationId.description: The Keycloak-assigned UUID of the organization.

keycloakOrganizationName.description: The organization name as reported by Keycloak; null until the first successful organization sync.

disabledAt.description: The time this organization was observed as absent from or not enabled in Keycloak by a sync; null if the organization is still live in Keycloak.

members.description: The organization's current cached members as cached users; null when the caller may not see membership data.

formerMembers.description: The organization's former members, the cached users whose cached membership Keycloak no longer reports; null when the caller may not see membership data.
